_comment: Cost-optimized single-node cluster for POC. Target: < $10 CAD total.
_cost_estimate: ~$0.10-0.20 CAD/hour on smallest paid tier. Full pipeline run ~2-3 hrs = $0.20-0.60 CAD. Community Edition = $0.

spark_conf._comment_shuffle: Default 200 is wasteful on small data; 8 matches core count

azure_attributes._comment: Spot instances reduce cost ~60-80%. Fallback to on-demand if no spot available.

_community_edition_note: Community Edition clusters auto-terminate after 2 hours and cannot be configured via JSON. Use the UI to set: Runtime=14.3LTS, Single Node, auto-terminate 120min.
